usage: speechloom transcribe [-h] [--ffmpeg FFMPEG] [--ffprobe FFPROBE]
                             [--nemo-speech NEMO_SPEECH] [--model MODEL]
                             [--diar-model DIAR_MODEL]
                             [--translation-model TRANSLATION_MODEL]
                             [--source-language SOURCE_LANGUAGE]
                             [--translate-to TRANSLATE_TO] [--device DEVICE]
                             [-o DIRECTORY] [--formats FORMATS]
                             [--audio-stream AUDIO_STREAM] [--recursive]
                             [--diarize] [--workers WORKERS]
                             [--shared-model | --no-shared-model]
                             [--keep-audio] [--force] [--fail-fast]
                             [--resume | --no-resume] [--json]
                             inputs [inputs ...]

positional arguments:
  inputs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ffmpeg FFMPEG
  --ffprobe FFPROBE
  --nemo-speech NEMO_SPEECH
  --model MODEL
  --diar-model DIAR_MODEL
  --translation-model TRANSLATION_MODEL
  --source-language SOURCE_LANGUAGE
                        Spoken language, for example ru
  --translate-to TRANSLATE_TO
                        Translate transcript outputs, for example en
  --device DEVICE       auto, cpu, cuda[:N], metal, vulkan[:N], or gpu[:N]
  -o DIRECTORY, --output-dir DIRECTORY
                        Write transcription job directories here (default:
                        transcripts)
  --formats FORMATS     Comma-separated: json,txt,srt,vtt
  --audio-stream AUDIO_STREAM
                        FFmpeg audio stream index
  --recursive           Recurse into input directories
  --diarize             Enable integrated Sortformer diarization
  --workers WORKERS
  --shared-model        Use one native directory invocation for multi-file
                        jobs (default)
  --no-shared-model     Invoke the native runtime separately for each input
  --keep-audio
  --force               Recompute and atomically replace job artifacts
  --fail-fast           Stop scheduling after the first failure
  --resume
  --no-resume
  --json                Emit machine-readable job results
